nom: EltaMD Skin Recovery Overnight Face Mask

segments.dry: Reviewers are split on dry skin: one whose skin is dry from Accutane says it keeps her skin hydrated and happy, while others report the mask is surprisingly drying, doesn't feel hydrating enough to last the night, or say they don't think it suits dry skin at all.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including one who describes her skin and eyes as intensely sensitive and another managing Accutane-related dryness and sensitivity, consistently report no irritation and wake up with calm, soft, hydrated skin.
segments.mature: One reviewer says she doesn't think the mask is suited for mature skin, noting the initial silky-soft feel faded within about an hour.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe it as hydrating, with skin feeling soft and plump by morning; several dissenting reviews say it is surprisingly drying, not hydrating enough to last the night, or that the initial soft feeling fades within about an hour, with two calling it unsuited to dry skin specifically.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with acne-prone skin says it visibly reduces her redness and inflammation in under twelve hours, faster than it normally fades on its own.
concerns.spots: One reviewer used this to recover her skin after a dark-spot treatment left it very dry and irritated, saying a couple of nights of use brought her skin back to normal, hydrated and healthy.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone skin report good tolerance when introduced gradually, using it as a final layer over retinol and moisturizer, and say their skin looks fresh and calmer by morning without new breakouts.

aspects.libelle: Push-pump jar is fussy to use fully
Some jars arrive without a safety seal
Works best layered over other products

extraits.texte: I love Elta MD. I use their sunscreen everyday. But this overnight face mask was so drying on me. I tried it twice and same outcome. I was disappointed.

extraits.titre: Lightweight - Love dispenser - Not hydrating enough
extraits.texte: It did not come with a safety seal around the box, jar, or under the lid. The expiration date (2025/06) is on the jar and box. I believe it’s made in the USA. I love how the cream dispenses from the jar. It’s more hygienic and less inconvenient than using a spoon to scoop. You press down at the top and it comes out like a water fountain. I have seen the brand EltaMD around but never owned a product by them. I’m thankful that Amazon Vine gave me this opportunity to try. From their website: “While we sleep, our skin enters recovery mode—repairing and regenerating itself up to three times faster at night than during the day. It’s time to make the most of our skin’s natural cycles. Our New Skin Recovery Night Mask combines Chronobiology Technology and our patented AAComplex to strengthen the skin barrier, visibly reduce the appearance of redness, improve hydration, and give skin a well-rested, radiant glow. Studies demonstrate that a strong skin barrier makes skin less susceptible to UV damage, making sure it can stand up to whatever the day brings.” The night mask was absorbent, non-sticky, non-oily, and non-irritating. Consistency is like a gel lotion so it was easy to apply. It’s an opaque light blue cream. It smells like baby wipes that are unscented. Nighttime skincare is usually more rich or intense. extraits.titre: Well tolerated by my sensitive skin and eyes
extraits.texte: My intensely sensitive skin and eyes tolerate the Elta MD skin recovery overnight. Unfortunately, I don't get to say that very often about products. With this product, I wake up in the morning with calm, soft, plump skin with no eye irritation.

extraits.titre: Great as a last step in my skincare & for acne prone skin
extraits.texte: I am always hesitate to try new products as I struggle with acne and do a lot to keep it at bay. I use this brands sunscreen and love it so thought I would try this product out. I started with just putting it on my forehead & neck for the first week to make sure I wasn’t going to react to it. Luckily, this is a great product - I now use it nightly all over my face/neck (even the tops of my hands) as my last step over my retinol and moisturizer. I wake up with fresh, soft and tight skin! This is not a heavy cream so don’t expect it to be super moisturizing by itself - you need to layer prior to apply this as your last step. Overall, I love it! I hope this was helpful for you! 👍🏼

extraits.titre: Leaves Skin Smooth and Reduces Redness
extraits.texte: I have used this Face Mask for three weeks before reviewing. I am very impressed by the results of using this mask. I have acne prone skin with redness that can take several days to go away. This is the perfect mask to quickly reduce redness and inflammation in under 12 hours. The mask feels smooth and then dries on the skin but is comfortable while wearing it. It is pricey; however, the quality and results are amazing. It also leaves the skin looking smoother after several uses. I highly recommend trying this one out!

I really like EltaMD skin products, and this night cream is not the exception. After doing a treatment for dark spots, my skin was very dry and irritated. This cream really made the difference, after a couple of days of applying it before bed time, my skin was back to normal and looking hydrated and healthy again. Absolutely recommended!
I love this night cream. It keeps my dry, sensitive skin (thanks, Accutane) hydrated and happy.
